# Ola Gustafsson - Akvarellgalleri / Watercolor Gallery

This site is the portfolio and online gallery of watercolor artist Ola Gustafsson.

## Pages
- Home: /
- Gallery: /gallery.html
- Studio (admin): /studio.html (not for indexing)

## Language
- Swedish (default): add `?lang=sv`
- English: add `?lang=en`
